# Marshall Elliott

[Grit](../codex/factions.md#grit)

## Overview

- **Age:** about fifty  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P32](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0032), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P11](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0011), [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT FOUR WINDS P28](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0028), [v5 CHAPTER II. - **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Marshall Elliott maintains an unshaven face and long hair. He made a vow to refrain from shaving or cutting his hair until the [Grits](../codex/factions.md#grit) achieve power.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034)_

## Personality

Marshall Elliott is a witty, intelligent, and well-read individual who exhibits a determined nature alongside a notable temper, particularly becoming furious when hearing of a child being mistreated. He often avoids taking things seriously, but he possesses impressive talents for storytelling and singing old Scotch ballads in a fine tenor voice.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P6](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P9](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0009), [v4 CHAPTER 37 MISS CORNELIA MAKES A STARTLING ANNOUNCEMENT P15](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0015), [v4 CHAPTER 37 MISS CORNELIA MAKES A STARTLING ANNOUNCEMENT P17](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0017), [v5 CHAPTER VIII. MISS CORNELIA INTERVENES P8](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0008), [v5 CHAPTER XXVI. MISS CORNELIA GETS A NEW POINT OF VIEW P11](../source/v05-c26.md#nw-v05-c26-p0011)_

## History

In his youth, Marshall Elliott was a noted dancer who vowed not to cut his hair or shave until the Liberals won power. Years later, he attended a New Year's Eve celebration at the [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds) lighthouse, where he danced around the fire with [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md). After the Liberals eventually won the general election, Marshall fulfilled his vow and shaved his beard. Later, when [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) was asked to adopt [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md), she agreed to take the girl after consulting with Marshall.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P3](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P6](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P11](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0011), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P21](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0021), [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT FOUR WINDS P6](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0006), +7 more_

## Relationships

### [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/marshall-elliott--uncle-jim.md)

Marshall Elliott and Captain Jim are longtime friends and fishing companions who frequently socialize together. They celebrate occasions like New Year's Eve together at the [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds) lighthouse, where Marshall dances to Captain Jim's fiddle playing. Captain Jim also shares local news involving Marshall with their mutual friends, such as the outcome of the general election and Marshall's decision to shave his beard.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P3](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P6](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0006), +6 more_
